name: Notible Graph
description: ALPHA — a map of your workspace: every note, task and project is a dot, and lines show what links to what. Good for spotting notes that nothing points to and links between projects.
author: Notible
guide:
Open **Graph** in the sidebar.

## Reading it

- A bigger dot has more connections; the colour is its kind (note, task, project…).
- Solid lines are real links: something inside something, or a `[[link]]`. Faint lines are guesses from shared tags and words, and say why when you point at them.
- Point at a dot to fade everything not connected to it. Click a kind in the legend to hide it.

This is an early version: the look may still change.
